gaps: Specimen geometry conflict in the source: 100 × 200 mm cylinders (§2.2) versus 50 × 100 mm (Figure 3, §2.3); resolve before any batch sheet.
The 32.2–34.5 MPa control range is not attributed to one paste in the notes, so it is not entered as a result.
Part-level strength, absorption and pH values are graph-only and not digitized; NSFS has no text-stated strength.
Activator solution masses and total water differ between NHFS and NSFS and are not given; the two pastes are matched on OH⁻ concentration, not composition.
Mixing time, speed and consolidation are not stated in the inspected methods.
